maya: Bringing up solaris9b (open ckpt) with int4. Quick eval shows coherent answers but massive name hallucinations in QA tests. Any hints? :grimacing:

eric: Did you convert tokenizer? Often name/entity hallucinations correlate with token id shifts for named entities. Which conversion flags used?

maya: Used our default: `python tools/convert_ckpt.py --in solaris9b/ --out models/solaris9b/redwood --tokenizer bpe --norm NFKC` then `tools/quantize.py --mode int4 --scheme per_channel`.

rachel: Two fast checks: (1) compare token mapping for top 5k tokens; (2) dump rotary sin/cos small slice. Solaris was trained with rotary.base_mult=1.05 and head-layout contiguous. If either changed, position handling or head indexing could scramble entity resolution.

eric: Also watch for soft-hyphen/zero-width variants. Solaris training had mixed NF* behavior; conversion to NFKC can fuse ligatures and shift ids for names like "O'Neal".

maya: Quick diffs: token id for "O'Neal" changed 4521->4523, and several common capitals shifted. rotor dump shows `rotary.base_mult` missing in meta.json; sin table present but heads listed as interleaved in export metadata.

ops-bot: Alert: runtime/kv_cache reported repeated 'kv_cache index mismatch' during canary warmup logs. See /var/logs/canary/8639991234.log

rachel: That explains symptoms. Plan: (A) reconvert tokenizer with training norm (try NFC) and frequency-aware remap for top-2k tokens; (B) re-export rotary meta from float ckpt (preserve base_mult) and force head-layout contiguous in export or add runtime remap; (C) quantize with symmetric_per_channel and preserve rotary FP16.

maya: Ran (A) + (B) locally. Token remap recovered named-entity ids, and keeping rotary FP16 improved QA F1 from 0.62 -> 0.78 (float baseline 0.81). Int4 still slightly noisy but much closer.

eric: Good. For release: add converter lint that flags head_layout != contiguous and missing rotary.base_mult. Also add an onboarding note: prefer symmetric_per_channel for solaris family. File a ticket ML-ONB-8759 with repro artifacts.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: solaris9b-int4-canary in us-west-2 (4 reps). Dashboard: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/8639991234

maya: Uploading repro + diffs to ticket now. Thanks all :rocket:
